title: Design System: Teung’s Space — Night Desk

display.purpose: Lora welcome headline with responsive sizing.

title.purpose: Serif names in the vertical music library.

body.purpose: General copy and everyday interface text.

label.purpose: Compact field labels and supporting controls.

shadows.name: profile
shadows.purpose: Lift beneath the circular Panda profile.

shadows.name: player
shadows.purpose: Lift beneath the single glass listening surface; the player itself has no shadow.

shadows.name: queue
shadows.purpose: Flat in-flow queue between deck and collection.

motion.name: room-material
motion.value: 30fps desktop / 24fps phone targets; bounded canvas resolution
motion.purpose: Continuous window rain, noodle vapour and local lamplight, aligned with the scene crop. Independent of audio; paused by shared motion preference, hidden tab, offscreen scene. Original image is the fallback.

motion.name: vinyl-portal
motion.purpose: Finite Home entrance with SVG record geometry and native Web Animations. Replay enables motion explicitly; Skip, Escape, hidden tab, resize or navigation cancels it without changing playback.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Background, color and play-overlay state changes.

motion.name: profile-transition
motion.purpose: A -3deg profile rotation on hover-capable pointers.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Initial motion preference. The header can persist an explicit teung.motion override; disabled motion removes transitions and loops and hides video. Hidden tabs cancel active sequences.

narrative.overview: After Hours Home keeps the open room, biography and Discord/tools. A compact glass vinyl player occupies the bottom-right corner at around one quarter of desktop width. Library and queue open on demand above it; there is no separate Music tab.
keyCharacteristics: Forest and charcoal surfaces with ivory text.
Muted olive for primary actions and selected controls.
Lora headings and track titles with DM Sans controls.
Personal Panda identity and a distinct live Discord presence.
Open Home, compact corner vinyl, collection available on demand.

rules.name: The Olive State Rule
rules.body: Use olive fill for the existing primary actions and selected controls. A current track uses a darker forest highlight, preserving the distinction between playback position and a filled action.

rules.name: The Two Type Voices Rule
rules.body: Use Lora for the implemented names, headings and track titles; use DM Sans for controls, metadata and form labels.

rules.name: The Quiet Layers Rule
rules.body: Preserve the tonal and border hierarchy already used by the shell and library. Use the existing shadows for the profile, player and queue.

dos: Do use the shared forest, ivory and olive tokens for new controls and surfaces.
Do preserve Lora for headings and track titles, and DM Sans for controls and metadata.
Do keep the Panda as the main profile identity and the original photo within Discord.
Do preserve visible olive focus outlines and text labels for icon actions.
Do keep footer content reachable behind the compact dock.
Do show Library and queue on demand above the player.
donts: Don't replace the established palette or type pairing with a separate visual system.
Don't style the current track as a filled primary action; keep its darker forest highlight.
Don't turn the vertical music library into a horizontal carousel.
Don't hide the meaning of presence or playback state behind color alone.
Don't replace Home with a permanent music workspace or full-width bottom bar.
